definitions.explanation: The government agency that handles the affairs of the Imperial family, including ceremonies, the Imperial Palace, and the Emperor's official duties.

examples.japanese: {宮内庁|くないちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The Imperial Household Agency made an announcement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{皇居|こうきょ}→皇居：13607_koukyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{参観|さんかん}→参観：16172_sankan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{宮内庁|くないちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}む→申し込む：02311_moushikomu⟧。
examples.english: Tours of the Imperial Palace are booked through the Imperial Household Agency.

examples.japanese: {宮内庁|くないちょう}⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、{天皇陛下|てんのうへいか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪問|ほうもん}される→訪問する：26836_houmonsuru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧。
examples.english: According to the Imperial Household Agency, His Majesty the Emperor is scheduled to visit the regions next month.

notes:
{宮内|くない} (inside the palace) + {庁|ちょう} (agency). Note the reading くない, not きゅう⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {宮内庁|くないちょう}{御用達|ごようたし}: "purveyor to the Imperial Household", a prestige label on long-established shops and products (officially abolished in 1954 but still used informally)
- {宮内庁|くないちょう}⟦{長官|ちょうかん}→長官：31459_choukan⟧: head of the Imperial Household Agency

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{皇室|こうしつ}→皇室：11339_koushitsu⟧: the Imperial family
- ⟦{皇居|こうきょ}→皇居：13607_koukyo⟧: the Imperial Palace
